texts.Payments_Detail_BankFailed: The bank payment did not go through.
texts.Payments_Detail_Cancelled: The automatic payments were cancelled at the processor.
texts.Payments_Detail_ChargeFailed: An automatic payment failed. The processor tries again on its own schedule.
texts.Payments_Detail_Expired: The checkout was not finished in time.
texts.Payments_Detail_Reversed: The payment was reversed at PayPal, for example by a chargeback.
texts.Payments_Error_BadAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
texts.Payments_Error_BadCurrency: Use a three letter currency code, like USD.
texts.Payments_Error_BadUrl: The return addresses must start with https://.
texts.Payments_Error_NoDescription: Describe what the payment is for.
texts.Payments_Error_NoSubscription: This recurring gift has no automatic payments at the processor to update.
texts.Payments_Error_NotReady: {0} is not connected yet. Ask your BarnCRM admin to connect it on Payments Setup.
texts.Payments_Error_Processor: {0} could not start the checkout. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Payments_Event_Duplicate: Already received: this event was applied once.
texts.Payments_Event_NoMove: Not applied: a payment cannot move from {0} to {1}.
texts.Payments_Event_NoPayment: No BarnCRM payment matches this event, so it was left alone.
texts.Payments_Event_NotUsed: Payments does not use this kind of event.
texts.Payments_Event_NotFoundAtStripe: Stripe has no event with this ID in the connected account, so nothing was applied. It was not sent by Stripe, or belongs to another Stripe account.
texts.Payments_Event_NotVerified: PayPal did not confirm this event, so it was not applied. Check the Webhook ID on Payments Setup.
texts.Payments_Health_ConnectionFailedDetail: A test call to {0} through its Named Credential failed ({1}), so checkouts and payment news fail too. In Setup, check the secret on its External Credential principal and that your permission sets give access to that principal, then choose Check Connection on Payments Setup.
texts.Payments_Health_GuestAccessDetail: Stripe and PayPal send payment news to the Site, and public pages on it start checkouts, so its guest user needs the Payments Webhook Guest permission set. It grants the receiver and access to the processor credentials (never their values), and no record.
texts.Payments_Health_GuestAccessDone: Payments Webhook Guest given to the guest user of: {0}.
texts.Payments_Health_GuestAccessTitle: A Site Guest User Can't Receive Payment News
texts.Payments_Health_KeysMissingDetail: {0} is the chosen processor, but it is not connected, so no checkout can start. Enter its secrets on its External Credential in Setup, then choose Check Connection on Payments Setup (PayPal also needs its Webhook ID there).
texts.Payments_Health_ModeMismatchDetail: Payments is in {0} mode, but the Stripe secret key on the BarnCRM Stripe External Credential is for the other mode. Enter the key that matches in Setup, or change the mode in Settings.
texts.Payments_Health_ModeMismatchTitle: Stripe Key Does Not Match the Mode
texts.Payments_Health_NoSiteDetail: Stripe and PayPal tell BarnCRM about payments through a Salesforce Site, and this org has no active Site. Create and activate one in Setup, under Sites. The admin guide page Payments shows the steps.
texts.Payments_Health_CapReachedDetail: The receiver reached its hourly limit of stored events for a processor in the last day and refused the rest, which the processor sends again later. Check the Error Log for the hour, and on Payments Setup choose Regenerate Token if the address may have been shared.
texts.Payments_Health_CapReachedTitle: Payment Receiver Hit Its Hourly Limit
texts.Payments_Health_NotScheduledDetail: Received payment events are applied every 15 minutes by a scheduled job, which is not scheduled. Until it is, payments stay Pending.
texts.Payments_Health_NotScheduledDone: Payments processing is scheduled every 15 minutes, as you.
texts.Payments_Health_WaitingDetail: Some payment events were received over an hour ago and are not applied yet. Check that processing is scheduled and that the person who scheduled it is still active.
texts.Payments_Setup_DisconnectConfirm: BarnCRM stops using {0} until you check its connection again. The keys stay on its External Credential in Setup.
texts.Payments_Setup_DisconnectConfirmPayPal: BarnCRM stops using {0} until you check its connection again, and erases the Webhook ID saved for it. The keys stay on its External Credential in Setup.
texts.Payments_Setup_Addresses: Give the processor the full address for it, including the token after the question mark. Each address is on the Site named beside it. A post without the token is refused.
texts.Payments_Setup_RegenerateConfirm: The addresses you gave Stripe and PayPal will stop working. Paste the new addresses into each processor's webhook settings, or its events will not reach BarnCRM.
texts.Payments_Setup_CheckFailed: {0} could not be reached through its Named Credential (answer: {1}). In Setup, check the secrets on its External Credential principal and that your permission sets give access to that principal. The Error Log has the detail.
texts.Payments_Setup_CredentialSteps: In Setup, open Named Credentials, then the External Credentials tab, and open {0}. Under Principals, edit {1} and add each authentication parameter, named exactly {2}, with its value from your processor account. Payments Staff, Payments Admin and Payments Webhook Guest already give access to this principal. The Named Credentials it serves: {3}. Then choose Check Connection.
texts.Payments_Setup_Failed: Payments Setup could not load or save. Try again. If it happens again, check the Error Log.
texts.Payments_Setup_Intro: Connect your own Stripe or PayPal account. Payers pay on the processor's own page; BarnCRM keeps no card details. Processor secrets are entered in Salesforce Setup, on External Credentials that BarnCRM ships empty, and are never shown to or stored by BarnCRM.
texts.Payments_Setup_Mode: Mode: {0}. Checkouts use {1} unless a module asks for the other. Change these in Settings, under Payments.
texts.Payments_Setup_NoManage: Checking a connection, disconnecting and saving the Webhook ID need the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission. Ask your BarnCRM admin.
texts.Payments_Setup_NoSite: This org has no active Salesforce Site with an address, so there is nothing to give the processor yet. Create and activate a Site in Setup, under Sites; the admin guide page Payments shows the steps.
texts.Payments_Setup_NotScheduled: Processing is not scheduled, so nothing the processor reports reaches BarnCRM: payments stay Pending. Choose Schedule Processing to check for processor news every 15 minutes, run as you.
texts.Payments_Setup_Scheduled: Processing is scheduled: processor news is applied every 15 minutes, and checkouts abandoned for two days are cancelled.
